WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    film.rating,
    AVG(film.length) as avg_length,
    AVG(CAST(film.rental_rate AS REAL) / film.rental_duration) as avg_price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY film.rating
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) as avg_all_ratings
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.rating,
    step1.avg_length,
    step1.avg_price_per_day,
    step1.avg_price_per_day - step2.avg_all_ratings as diff
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.avg_price_per_day > step2.avg_all_ratings
)
SELECT 
  AVG(step3.avg_length) as answer_col1,
  AVG(step3.avg_price_per_day) as answer_col2,
  AVG(step3.diff) as answer_col3
FROM step3
